prompt: Animate THIS EXACT approved creature, preserving its silhouette, anatomy, carved ivory mask, braided wood limbs, turquoise cloth with gold trim, amber eye and green leaves. Create a PRODUCTION TRANSPARENT sprite sheet: exactly FOUR equal columns and SEVEN equal rows = 28 frames. Tall 4:7 canvas. Generous empty gutters, nothing touches cell boundaries. Fixed horizontal body anchor; a common floor at 85% of every cell (for flyer common flight center). Same detailed pixel clusters as reference; NOT smooth illustration and NOT coarse oversized blocks. Each row is four consecutive DISTINCT articulated poses, not a translated or resized duplicate. Rows in strict order: 1 idle breathing loop, 2 movement loop, 3 attack anticipation neutral-to-ready, 4 attack action, 5 recovery back to idle, 6 hurt recoil returning balance, 7 death buckle/fall to final inert corpse. No disappearance. Preserve character's identity in every frame. Flying ivory-winged wooden bird with turquoise mantle, amber eye, tiny gold chest bell. Keep all wing tips and tail inside generous cell gutters. Idle four gentle hovering wingbeats. Move stronger four-frame flight wingbeat cycle, torso held at fixed flight center. Anticipation wings draw up and back, head tilts down for dive. Attack pointed forward-down diving pose then wings extend, same anchor no frame translation. Recovery wings flare into braking then hover. Hurt wings fold asymmetrically with head recoil. Death wings droop, body rolls, ends lying sideways wings folded, same bottom contact baseline for final corpse.
